decisions.rationale: Dead oak, re-cooked from W0 with a middle level of detail: a thick forked bole and a leafless crown of bare branches with a few dead leaves; 2 variants 9.5-11.0 m tall; at most 2,091 triangles near, 469 in the middle level of detail and a 6-triangle impostor; 405,380 bytes before meshopt. Parts, triangle budget and impostor checked by the world-assets suite; baked AO.
limitations: Its bark is the spruce layer; there is no oak bark.

decisions.rationale: In open woods and lone trees across the Heartlands, Fenlands, Salt Coast, Ash Steppe, Crownlands and Frostspine, and the Old Orchard, at gameplay cameras (18-40 m, pitch 0.38-1.13): reads at natural scale beside the 2.25 m soldier, the 2.7 m captain and the 3.9 m boss (trees are not scaled up), with shadows on the ground. Distance bands: near parts to 24 m (spruce, birch and oaks have a middle level there), the middle level to 58 m and impostors to 235 m; the canopy cutaway cone (3-6 m at the hero, twice that at the camera) keeps the hero visible inside the forest.
limitations: Card foliage reads flat and dark where a tree stands beside the camera at mid-distance; the sightline cone keeps the hero and the ground round them clear.
